(() => { const btn = document.querySelector('[data-testid="Save dashboard drawer button"]'); if (!btn) return 'btn not found'; let el = btn; for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) { el = el.parentElement; if (!el) break; if (el.getAttribute && (el.getAttribute('role') === 'dialog' || /drawer/i.test(el.className || ''))) return {found: true, cls: el.className.substring(0,80), text: el.textContent.substring(0,600)}; } return 'no dialog ancestor'; })()

(() => { const closeBtn = document.querySelector('[data-testid="Drawer close"]'); if (!closeBtn) return 'no close btn'; let drawer = closeBtn.closest('[class*="drawer"], [class*="Drawer"]'); if (!drawer) { let el = closeBtn; for (let i=0;i<12;i++){ el = el.parentElement; if(!el) break; if (/drawer/i.test(el.className||'')) { drawer = el; break; } } } return drawer ? {cls: drawer.className.substring(0,60), text: drawer.textContent.substring(0,1000)} : 'no drawer found'; })()

(() => { const els = document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid*="Drawer"], [data-testid*="drawer"]'); return Array.from(els).map(e => ({testid: e.getAttribute('data-testid'), visible: e.offsetParent !== null})); })()
